title: Sustain
excerpt: Hey y'all, So I was looking for a simple way to implement a sustain pedal...
content:
Hey y'all,
So I was looking for a simple way to implement a sustain pedal in orac without going through and editing all the patches. This is what I came up with, as an extremely basic PD user. I imagine there's an entirely different/better way of doing this that eludes me. It's modified from the Arper module, so there's detritus of that still in there. 

If you place it in front of a synth or a sequencer that support latching/sustain, it will work. Couple things: 1.) the module has to be active in order to work, not sure how to get around that, really cuts down on ability to tweak other modules while sustaining; 2.) there's something weird going on with polyphony/voice stealing that I can't figure out-- if you sustain some notes and then take your hand away, and then play another note, it won't incorporate new voices, it will just cut the old ones off.

Any comments and suggestions welcome!
